about.heading: Made With a Little More Care
about.imageAlt: Barista brewing a slow pour-over coffee
about.para1: The Quiet Cup began with a simple idea: good coffee, fresh ingredients and a space that lets you slow down. From your first coffee of the day to a quiet afternoon break, there is always a seat for you.
about.para2: We roast small batches of single-origin beans every morning, bake our croissants at dawn, and keep the room calm enough to read in. No rushing, no noise — just thoughtful coffee and warm things, made slowly.

reviews.heading: Reflections From the Room

items.name: Mahnoor D.
items.text: A peaceful haven away from Islamabad's rush. The Spanish latte and their butter croissants are my Saturday morning staple.

items.name: Daniyal K.
items.text: The pour-over coffee is roasted to perfection, and their butter croissants are dangerously good. Easily the finest cafe in town.

items.name: Sarah T.
items.text: You can actually read a book in silence without loud music. Impeccable coffee craft and lovely warm beans.

items.name: Ahmed R.
items.text: Kashmiri chai here tastes like my grandmother's recipe. Quiet corners, honest prices, and staff who remember your order.

items.name: Fatima S.
items.text: The light through those windows is magic. I come for the matcha, stay for the calm, and leave with full memory cards.

items.name: Zain A.
items.text: Best study spot in Islamabad. Free Wi-Fi, gentle playlist, and a cold brew that keeps me going till closing.
